chapter: Trombone technique, plunger mute and the California years
title: Tricky Sam Nanton, the first plunger trombonist
summary: He met the trombonist who started plunger playing out West and learns he died in 1947.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Growl, plunger and derby: the trumpet mute tradition

blocks.x: There's been quite a few trumpet players that used plungers. But the one on the trombone, that first started trombone playing with the plunger, was Joe Nanton -- you know, Tricky Sam.
You heard him on records and stuff?

Yeah... I met him years ago. In the early Thirties, I met him. It could have been in the Twenties. Anyway, I met him out West. He didn't live too very much longer after this... I guess he lived seven or eight more years, I think.
No. He just... They were on the road, I guess, and he...
